sections.title: Minigames & Secrets
sections.note: The minigames and hidden stations with a lasting prize: upgrades, Heart Containers, and the Alchemy Stones and Regal Rings the Golden Train needs. Prizes also counted elsewhere say so.

items.name: Take 'Em All On! level 1
items.howTo: The green door in the building at the south-east of Castle Town (50 Rupees): 10 rooms ending with Stagnox. No hearts drop, so bring potions.

items.name: Russell's training
items.howTo: After the Snow Temple, answer Russell's letter: land 60 hits on his three guards before taking three hits.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki: 60–119 hits then give an uncommon Treasure, 120–199 a rare one, 200+ a Regal Ring or Alchemy Stone, and 900 hits makes you captain.

items.name: Beedle's club
items.howTo: Buy something from Beedle, then join his club for 100 Rupees; the cards come by post. One point per 10 Rupees spent.
items.notes: His stock changes daily. After the Diamond Card no more points are counted.

tiers.name: Club Card
tiers.howTo: Join for 100 Rupees after your first purchase.

tiers.name: Gold Card
tiers.reward: 20% off and a Heart Container (also in Heart Containers)

tiers.name: Platinum Card
tiers.reward: 30% off and a Quintuple Points Card

items.name: Whip Race: under 1:30
items.howTo: Swing across north Whittleton with the Whip to the race in the north-east corner (50 Rupees) and finish in under 1:30.
items.notes: IGN says under 2:00 in one place; Zelda Wiki says beat the current record.

items.name: Whip Race: under 1:15
items.howTo: Finish the Whip Race in under 1:15 without falling.
items.notes: Later fast runs give rare Treasure; under 1:05 also cuts the fee to 25 Rupees (IGN).

items.name: Take 'Em All On! level 2
items.howTo: The blue door (50 Rupees): 14 rooms with Stagnox, Fraaz and Phytops.
items.notes: Purple Potions don't revive you here; drink them yourself (IGN).

items.name: Snowdrift Station
items.howTo: The four side chambers each hold a clue to the five switches. From the high platform hit, left to right, the 1st, 4th, 2nd and 5th with one Boomerang throw (not the middle one), then beat the Freezards.

items.name: Slippery Station skating rink
items.howTo: Step on a course's switch and skate to its door before it shuts: bottom switch Amateur, middle Pro, top Champion. Cut the corners and use the patches of solid ground.

items.name: Goron Target Range
items.howTo: 20 Rupees a go: shoot blue targets (10 points) and red ones (30, up to three hits), not the Goron targets (minus 30). Pick one of two chests at the end.
items.notes: Prizes are only Treasure and Rupees.

items.name: Disorientation Station
items.howTo: Climb to the Castle Guard (Song of Birds and Whip for the ledges), then in the maze go east, south, north and north. Beat the Fire Babas and play the Song of Discovery by the stone block in the north-east.
items.after: Force Gem: Goron child in Castle Town
items.notes: Answer the guard "well" afterwards for a Big Green Rupee.

items.name: Pirate Hideout: 3,000 points
items.howTo: After freeing Wadatsumi, play the shooting gallery again (a Goron is the prisoner now) and score 3,000–3,999. Hit Miniblins in a row for the multiplier.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon says 3,500–4,000. Light Arrows add 10 points each.

items.name: Pirate Hideout: 4,000 points
items.howTo: Score 4,000 or more in the Pirate Hideout's shooting gallery.

items.name: Take 'Em All On! level 3
items.howTo: The red door (50 Rupees): 15 rooms with all five temple bosses, then Dark Link. Bring two potions and the Great Spin Attack.

items.name: Ends of the Earth block puzzles
items.howTo: Each of the three caves has three Sand Wand block-rolling puzzles: roll every block until its blue spike sits in a blue panel.
items.notes: Each cave also has a Big Green Rupee on the way out.

items.name: Lost at Sea Station
items.howTo: Ride a bird (Song of Birds and Whip) up the cliff, play the Song of Light at the beacon and bomb the wall it lights. Then clear five Phantom floors without the sword or bow: light the torches, blow out 13 torches, pull the right handles, smash every block and open all four chests.
items.notes: It can be repeated for more Regal Rings. The station also hides a rare Treasure where its two beacons' beams cross (Song of Discovery).
